name: Reply to “tell me more”
subjectVariants: A bit more on the idea
bodyMd:
{{#if contact.firstName}}Hello {{contact.firstName}},{{else}}Hello,{{/if}}

Thank you for getting back to me. In short: we would start from how your customers find and contact {{business.name}} today, then design a site that makes the next step obvious on a phone as much as on a laptop. We take care of the design, the wording and the technical side.

To tailor this, one question: what would you most want a new site to do for you, more bookings, fewer phone calls, or something else?

Best regards,
